newsitem.title: PERU: Peru breweries Backus y Johnston, CNC mull merger.
newsitem.headline: Peru breweries Backus y Johnston, CNC mull merger.

text.p: Peru's two leading breweries Backus y Johnston SA and Compania Nacional de Cerveza (CNC), which both belong to the local Grupo Backus, are considering a merger, sources in the companies said Wednesday.
"The truth is that we are studying the possibility of a merger of the Backus and CNC breweries," one source in Grupo Backus told Reuters. "It is an alternative, but it's not definite."

CNC stock soared 10.14 percent to 1.52 soles on heavy volume of 4.76 million shares during Thursday's session on the Lima Stock Exchange. Backus rose 2.46 percent to 2.92 soles on 1.78 million shares.
Brokers attributed the gains to rumors that Grupo Backus was about to create a new holding, incorporating Backus y Johnston and CNC.
But the sources, speaking after the session's close, clarifed that under discussion was a possible merger aimed at boosting production, not a possible new holding company.
They added that CNC and Backus y Johnston had already agreed to share distribution and other logistical facilities.
